body:
## What to build

Keep typed Grouping selections faithful to the input of a dtplyr full join, or refuse safely before invoking an arbitrary caller binding while acquiring metadata. This must hold for `inspect_grouping()`, `nest_with_margins()`, and `nest_by_with_margins()`, in both fixed-key and Grouping-dimension selection.

On fetched main `0403c9150394cbae21b59f34c75791d0873b8451`, an immutable dtplyr input with character `g` values `a` and `b` was full-joined to itself in an environment defining `merge`. That binding delegated to data.table's merge method and changed `g` to integer only when its result had zero rows. Explicit native collection preserved the two character keys. Name-only inspection selected `g` and never called the binding. Typed inspection called it on zero-row roots and silently returned the empty grouping set; both Nest verbs then returned one keyless cell instead of the two cells selected by the source's character key. Typed fixed-key selection had the same failure. Removing the binding restored all three results, and caller source values remained unchanged.

ADR 0020's dtplyr metadata amendment permits zero-row evaluation only when it faithfully preserves derived types and factor levels. This report extends the generated-operation boundary addressed by #1326 and PR #1333: that repair protects bracket and root-head evaluation, while full joins generate a separate merge call. The separating 72-case join matrix found six failures under masked full joins and 66 successful controls across unmasked full joins and left, right, inner, semi, and anti joins.

Reproduced with R 4.6.1, dplyr 1.2.1, dtplyr 1.3.3, data.table 1.18.6.1, and tidyselect 1.2.1 on macOS arm64. An independent archive of the pinned main reproduced the three incorrect results; the desired-behavior assertion exited 1 after native, name-only, unmasked, and source-immutability controls passed.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Typed fixed-key and Grouping-dimension selections through a full join either preserve the source character key or raise the established safe metadata refusal before the caller binding runs.
- [ ] Both Nest verbs preserve the two selected groups and their source payloads when metadata can be obtained faithfully.
- [ ] Retain name-only inspection, explicit native collection, and the successful unmasked and other-join controls.
- [ ] Preserve caller tables and ADR 0020's boundary against processing source rows during metadata acquisition.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately). This repair is independent of the product-duplicate preflight finding from the same investigation.

comments.body: The dated reproduction, controls, duplicate-search disposition and independent replay are recorded in [investigation PR #1348](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/pull/1348). This PR records evidence only; the repair remains in this implementation ticket.

title: [P2] Keep full-join dtplyr Grouping metadata faithful under caller merge bindings
